title: SCUS_973.16 Sly 2: Band of Thieves (NTSC-U) -- cel-shading judge fixture (verify/judge_cel.py)
note: Numbers only. Coordinates are field pixels (512x224). The twin is PCSX2 2.7.329 HW (DumpGSData SaveInfo + SaveTexture/SaveAlpha [+ SaveFrame] of the named frame); ours is the presented frame p<key>.ppm of the named state (headless, gs.queue=thread). char_box / char_z select the character's body-pass draws in the twin's draw list (every vertex inside, lerp pass ALPHA 0101 ATST GEQUAL); the mask they cover is applied to both frames.

palace_hub.scene: episode-2 palace (India jungle) hub, the spawn ledge, camera behind Sly (PCSX2 slot-3 state from the same rewritten save: per-draw dump f15 = wp_pcsx2/hwdump_ep2, frame PNG f16 fr1; ours states/hub_ep2.ps2st present key 11, NATIVEEE_GS_VERTS=11 TEX_DUMP=0,12). palace_hub.gate_note: report-only: the ink gates pass (visible 0.92, thickness 3 = 3, 999 vs 1033 ink lines) but contrast 0.79 and the tbp 258000 band set fail for reasons outside the ink: the twin's Sly carries the stencil self-shadow / ground shadow (its dark modes 28..32) which ours lacks in this hub with BOTH the baseline and fix/cel (the 28 shadow-class draws are emitted; the darkening never lands: judge_shadow item, no palace case there), and PCSX2 expands lines to a 1-px perpendicular band (2 px per step near 45 degrees) where the GS / ours draw the one-pixel DDA line, so its ink mean is darker. Re-gate once judge_shadow covers the palace.
